description: This file is a header (.h) file defining interfaces related to 'islands' in a delta compression context within version control or repository management. It declares functions for comparing, resolving, and propagating delta islands, as well as managing island marks and pack layer computations.

methods.name: island_delta_cmp
methods.description: Compare two object IDs to determine their delta island ordering or equality.

methods.name: in_same_island
methods.description: Check whether two object IDs belong to the same delta island.

methods.name: resolve_tree_islands
methods.description: Resolve and identify islands within a repository tree, possibly for packing optimization.

methods.name: load_delta_islands
methods.description: Load delta island information for a repository, potentially for analysis or packing.

methods.name: propagate_island_marks
methods.description: Propagate island markings through commits in a repository to maintain consistent island groupings.

methods.name: compute_pack_layers
methods.description: Compute layering information for packing data, related to delta islands.

methods.name: free_island_marks
methods.description: Free allocated memory or resources associated with island marks.
